verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents a sandbox that lets users try limited BigQuery capabilities at no cost and without a billing account. Dataform supports developing and testing transformation workflows. Neither is documented as an isolated test copy of production data that an agent can safely run against, so the core story is only partly met. Missing for 10: documented isolation of sandbox or test environments from production datasets, a way to clone or branch production data for testing, agent-oriented guidance on safe test execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.
